messages.text:
"Create a 2D survival game called Shadow Escape.

The player is trapped in a dark room. Collect 5 coins and avoid the enemy chasing you. Use arrow keys to move. If the enemy catches you, game over. Collect all coins to win.

Add a score counter, scary atmosphere, and restart button.
"
